text: Figure 12.35: Identification of subordinate UCM modules by the master UCM The individual UCMs offer their service and then the master UCM as the client calls a specific method in the server’s ServiceInterface to reveal the identifier of each server. In the case of this example there are three slave UCMs with identifier set to 1, 2, and 3. The master UCM instantiates a proxy for each of the slave UCMs such that the value of the respective identifier can be retrieved from the proxy in order to be able to communicate with a specific slave UCM. The master UCM or VUM can then instantiate proxies for each service offer and pro- grammatically access the respective server going forward. [constr_1691] UcmModuleInstantiation.identifier shall be unique Imposition time: IT_Mani ⌈The value of attribute UcmModuleInstantiation.identifier shall be unique for each Machine in a given vehicle. ⌋
